title: Ultrafiltration membranes in bioprocess clarification: fouling, cleaning and lifetime considerations

record.title: Ultrafiltration membranes in bioprocess clarification: fouling, cleaning and lifetime considerations
record.abstract: This chapter reviews the use of polymeric ultrafiltration membranes in the clarification and concentration of protein-rich bioprocess streams, with emphasis on the mechanisms governing flux decline, strategies for fouling prevention, and approaches for determining cleaning protocol effectiveness. Topics covered include: the role of protein conformation and aggregation state in foulant deposit formation; the resistance-in-series framework as a diagnostic and modelling tool; alkaline and oxidative CIP chemistries and their impact on membrane material integrity over extended operational lifetimes; and criteria for membrane replacement decisions based on irreversible fouling resistance accumulation. The chapter draws on experimental data from dairy whey, fermentation broth, and plant protein extract filtration studies conducted over the past decade. Practical guidance is provided for selecting membrane materials, operating conditions, and CIP schedules in industrial bioprocess clarification applications.
